request: MAG-68 — Tier 2 of RM58: Writer.Update and Writer.Delete require a vehicleref.Ref, the SQL guard becomes id AND tesla_id, and a delete that matches nothing stops looking like success.

tasks.title: Offline check — grep every Update/Delete call site before edits move the lines
Queries and sqlc — tesla_id guard on UpdateEntry/DeleteEntry, DeleteEntry becomes :execrows
Ports (charging.go) — Update/Delete take a vehicleref.Ref; Entry.TeslaID doc
Service (service.go) — Ref unwrap, e.TeslaID overwritten, Delete returns pgx.ErrNoRows on a miss
Tests — re-key the two cross-account guards onto tesla_id; the delete guard inverts its assertion
Docs (module-owned) — charging docs with no gateway dependency
Gateway call sites (LEADER-OWNED) — authorizeVehicle on the entry's tesla_id, Ref to the write ports
Cross-module-aware KB docs — the two use-case guides that describe the gateway flow
Final verification — build, vet, gofmt, guards

decisions.what: Tier 2 does the minimal gateway wiring: authorizeVehicle on the entry's tesla_id, Ref passed to the write ports. Tier 3 keeps the rest.
decisions.why: Tier 1 used the same pattern. The alternative merges tier 2 into the riskiest tier and makes one big review.

decisions.what: Update overwrites e.TeslaID from the Ref before any work, so resolveEnergy reads the proven car.
decisions.why: The module already overwrites caller values it owns (EnergySource, PriceSource). Without it, energy can be derived from an unproven car.

decisions.what: DeleteEntry becomes :execrows and Delete returns pgx.ErrNoRows on zero rows.
decisions.why: Update is :one and already reports not-found. The gateway maps a Delete error to a message, so a miss stops looking like success.

events.detail: Worker (Sonnet) wrote proposal/design/tasks and a 4-requirement delta spec. openspec validate --strict passes. No design gate: design.md D9 states no database object changes. Budget after the artifacts wave: five_hour_pct 47, context_pct 13.
TestDelete_CrossVehicleGuard inverts its own assertion: it asserts err == nil today and must assert a non-nil error wrapping pgx.ErrNoRows after D9. Easy to miss during implementation.
